routine.bedtime_reminder: Bedtime in {minutes} minutes (at {bedtime}). Time to wrap up.
routine.wake_challenge.fingers: Good morning! Hold up {n} fingers and send a photo of yourself, out of bed.
routine.wake_challenge.sink: Good morning! Send a photo of yourself at the sink.
routine.wake_challenge.object: Good morning! Hold up an object you can see in the room and send a photo of yourself.
routine.wake_photo_late: That photo came after the time window, so it does not count as your wake-up proof.
routine.wake_photo_pending: I am still checking your first photo. Please wait for the result.
routine.wake_photo_unclear: I could not tell from that photo. Please send another one.
routine.wake_photo_failed: That photo did not show the check-in. The result can be appealed.
